rows.en:
(School's finally over for today~
I'm hungry, so maybe I'll grab something
to eat on the way home...)
(Oh, it's Pinon-chan... I know!)
Heeey, Pinon-chan!

Hm, what do you want,
\p?
Are you free after this, Pinon-chan?

Well, I suppose I'm free, if you want
to call it that...

That's great!
Then want to grab something on the way home?
Oh yeah, there's this popular ice cr...
Hmm?! You mean snacking on the way home?

Y-yeah, well, I guess that's what it
comes down to...

As a teacher, I cannot overlook
such a violation of school rules!
Huh?! A violation of school rules...?

You didn't know?
Mihoshi Academy School Rule Article 25 says:
"Thou shalt not snack on the way home!"

(I bet not a single Mihoshi student
knows that rule even exists...)

So snacking on the way home is not allowed.
You go home first, and THEN...

(Hmm, if Pinon-sensei says that much,
I guess I really have no choice
but to go home...)

Okay, Pinon-chan.
I'll give up on the hippo-cow milk ice cream
that's all the rage at Folmo and go home......
H-hippo-cow milk ice cream!

That shop closes early, so there's no way
I'd make it if I went home first.
Hm? What's wrong, Pinon-chan?

W-well... If I, a teacher, come along,
I s-suppose I could allow you to snack
on the way home...

Let me make one thing clear:
it's not that I want to eat ice cream!

Huh? I can't put you to that much trouble,
Pinon-chan.

R-right! As a teacher, I just don't want
to see my student disappointed, that's all...

(Oh, right. Now that I think about it,
Pinon-chan loves sweets, doesn't she?)

Come on, let's go, quick!
It'd be a disaster if the shop closed!

Got it? I'm only going because I have to!
Because I HAVE to!
...Yes, yes, I got it, Pinon-sensei.
Haah~ So good...

We only get to snack on the way home like this
thanks to you, Pinon-sensei.

That's right, it's all thanks to me,
so you'd better be grateful.
Hmm, I finished it already...
...I'm going to buy another one!
Don't eat too much and upset your stomach.

Don't worry! How could something this delicious
ever upset my stomach?!
(I don't think that's the point...)

(Pinon-chan... I mean, Pinon-sensei
was happy too, so I'm glad we came.)

(School's finally over for today~
I'm hungry, so maybe I'll grab something
to eat on the way home...)

That's great!
Then want to grab something on the way home?
Oh yeah, there's this popular ice cr...

Y-yeah, well, I guess that's what it
comes down to...

(I bet not a single Mihoshi student
knows that rule even exists...)

(Hmm, if Pinon-sensei says that much,
I guess I really have no choice
but to go home...)

Okay, Pinon-chan.
I'll give up on the hippo-cow milk ice cream
that's all the rage at Folmo and go home......

Huh? I can't put you to that much trouble,
Pinon-chan.

We only get to snack on the way home like this
thanks to you, Pinon-sensei.

(Pinon-chan... I mean, Pinon-sensei
was happy too, so I'm glad we came.)

(Haah~ I'm starving.
Maybe I'll grab something to eat
on the way home today.)

Hmm, \p...
Are you planning to snack on the way home?
Yeah, that's the plan, but...

Let me make one thing clear: the school rules
say snacking on the way home is...

I know, I know.
But if I go with you, Pinon-chan,
then it's not a problem, right?

Th-that's right...
I do care about my students, after all,
so I suppose I could go with you to Folmo...

Huh?! But I was thinking of stopping by
Nyan-Nyan today...
Huh?! Nyan-Nyan...!
The hippo-cow soft serve......

Just kidding! Suddenly I'm really craving
hippo-cow soft serve after all!

R-right?!
Okay, to Folmo, right now!

(With Pinon-chan giving me those eyes,
there's no way I could suggest Nyan-Nyan...)

(Haah~ I'm starving.
Maybe I'll grab something to eat
on the way home today.)

I know, I know.
But if I go with you, Pinon-chan,
then it's not a problem, right?

Just kidding! Suddenly I'm really craving
hippo-cow soft serve after all!

(With Pinon-chan giving me those eyes,
there's no way I could suggest Nyan-Nyan...)

uncertain: kaigui (buying food and eating it on the way home, against the school rules) rendered 'snacking on the way home' throughout the scene.
c11933: the rule quote rendered with mock-solemn 'Thou shalt not...' to match the classical -bekarazu ending.
c11944: 'So, sou!' read as Pinon seizing on the player's 'I can't trouble you' to justify going (she only does it so her student is not sad).
c11975: Pinon's sad murmur 'The hippo-cow soft serve......' (she wanted Folmo, the player proposed Nyan-Nyan).
